name: Sthana Bala (Positional Strength)
description: Strength derived from the planet's position in the zodiac (Exaltation, Mooltrikona, Own Sign).
calculation_logic: Planets in exaltation get maximum points; debilitation gets zero.

name: Dig Bala (Directional Strength)
description: Strength based on the house the planet occupies.
calculation_logic: Jupiter/Mercury strong in 1st house. Sun/Mars strong in 10th. Moon/Venus strong in 4th. Saturn strong in 7th.
